text: じいさん　あんまり　こうふん　すんなって　こんどこそ　おれが　ちゃんと　かんせいさせて　やるぜ！

structure.jp: あんまり　こうふん　すんなって
structure.en: don't get so worked up, I'm telling you

structure.jp: おれが　ちゃんと　かんせいさせて　やるぜ！
structure.en: I'll properly complete it for you!

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.span: かんせいさせて　やる
patterns.explanation: てやる after a verb says you will do it for someone, said from above or with swagger. かんせいさせて やる = 'I'll complete it for you'.

patterns.name: 〜な (prohibition)
patterns.explanation: な right after a plain verb is a blunt 'don't'. すんな is a rough squashed form of するな. こうふん すんな = 'don't get worked up'.

patterns.name: 〜って (insisting)
patterns.explanation: って at the end of what you say means 'I'm telling you', pressing the point on the listener. すんなって = 'don't, I'm telling you'.
